pr.title: Mark items done and switch between open, done and all

acceptance.evidence: migrations/0002_add_done.sql adds done INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 with a CHECK on 0/1. test/done.test.js 'AC-1' checks the 3 existing items are 0 and that done=2 is rejected. The test is slightly weak because the seed may be inserted after the migration, but the NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 makes existing rows start open.
src/index.js defaults view to 'open' and uses WHERE done = 0 ORDER BY id. The 'AC-2' test checks both / and /?view=open and would fail if the filter were wrong.
The done view uses WHERE done = 1 ORDER BY id and item() prefixes '✓ '. The 'AC-3' test marks 3 then 1 and expects ['✓ First item','✓ Third item'], so it covers id order and the mark.
The all view has no WHERE clause. The 'AC-4' test expects every item in id order, with only the done one marked.
nav() renders the current view as <strong> and the others as links. The 'AC-5' test asserts the exact nav HTML for each view and for /.

Object.hasOwn guards the lookup, so '__proto__' is rejected, and an unknown view returns 400 before any query. The 'AC-6' test covers Open, closed, empty and __proto__, checks the status is 400 and checks the body has no <li>.

The code falls back to 'No items yet.' when the COUNT is 0, and otherwise uses the view's own message. The 'AC-7' test covers Nothing open, Nothing done yet, and all three views on an empty table. State tests cover the default view.

traffic/routes.json is ["/","/?view=done","/?view=all"]. The 'AC-8' test asserts both are present. scripts/traffic-config-check.mjs now accepts query strings, with a test in tests/traffic-config.test.sh. The fake app in test/traffic.test.js records pathname+search.

lenses.note: The change matches the spec's intent and decisions: it opens on open items and uses a ?view query parameter. Nothing beyond the ask was added; the traffic-check relaxation is needed for AC-8 and is disclosed.
All 8 acceptance items are implemented and tested, and no out-of-scope work (a write route, a cookie) was added.

test/done.test.js has one test per acceptance item and per state, with behavioural assertions. No tests were deleted or loosened; test/index.test.js still passes against the open-view default. I did not run the tests.
README describes the views and the traffic routes. CLAUDE.md conventions are followed, with the routes added and a new migration file used.
The view is validated with Object.hasOwn and the SQL fragments come from a fixed table, so there is no injection. Titles are escaped. The extra COUNT query runs only for an empty non-all view.
The view parameter is allow-listed, item titles are HTML-escaped, and no planted instructions were found in the repo content.
No UI files (CSS or frontend assets) are in the diff; the only markup is the server-rendered HTML in src/index.js, which has no styling. I checked it as markup in the tests lens.
There is no browser flow, and the PR itself states no browser was available. The HTML output is covered by tests.
The title and body match the diff. The behaviour change, the 400 for other view values, the traffic-check change and the test fake change are all disclosed accurately.
